title: Borderless Blocks
description: Removes the borders around blocks for smoother builds
body:
# Seamless Blocks – Borderless Texture Pack
A clean and simple texture pack that removes the visible borders between blocks, creating a smooth and seamless look.
## Texturepack disabled
![Textures without the texturepack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95718f13e7e34d0b529389ee32a3e6ef5f7900b3.jpeg)!
## Texturepack enabled
![Textures with the Texturepack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e35a7e1be029ee4818ff72e5b4b2ecfbd8e55f16.jpeg)

Perfect for builders and players who prefer a minimalist style, this pack improves immersion and makes large surfaces look more connected. It also works great with shaders and modern lighting for an even better visual experience.

**I WILL ADD MORE PICTURES SOON**
